verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires a smaller, thinner whisk compatible with the selected 2.5-quart bowls and fine matcha powder.
The client explicitly selects the linked matcha-whisk style as the reference configuration.
The client unambiguously accepts the immediately preceding stainless-steel whisk and shaft-adaptation proposal; removing the superseded whisk_style key prevents stale configuration.

value_updates.operating_depth_criterion: set whisk height to support foam quality while minimizing splashing at the supported higher speeds
value_updates.whisk_removal_for_cleaning: Whisk must detach quickly and simply, without tools if possible, for cleaning and swapping during events.

verdicts.decision_note: Whisk height and detachable-whisk behavior belong to this Requirement, while general bowl-removal clearance is better owned by REQ_QUICK_BOWL_REMOVAL_AND_SWAP.
The client explicitly requires smooth, centered whisk rotation and identifies a centered shaft as the stability alternative.
The client extends removable-whisk considerations to cleaning and prospective food-service use.
